description: Maya is coordinating the sorting of a family's 30-kilogram apple harvest and must decide how it is divided, prepared, packaged, and delivered after checking in with three relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family has harvested 30 kilograms of apples from the backyard orchard.
shared_context.S2: The apples need to be sorted this weekend into family use, a community pantry donation, and freezer storage.
shared_context.S3: Maya is coordinating the harvest plan and will make the final call about the split and preparation.
shared_context.S4: The family usually goes around the table before sorting so each person can mention any practical details that should shape the plan.
shared_context.S5: Clean one-kilogram boxes, freezer containers, labels, and a kitchen scale are available.

PF1.text: Jonah spoke with Grandma yesterday, and she specifically asked for exactly 6 kilograms of the apples to be peeled and cooked into unsweetened applesauce because chewing whole apples is difficult for her; this has not reached the group yet.

PF2.text: Rosa confirmed with the community pantry coordinator that the pantry can accept exactly 12 kilograms of whole apples, packed as twelve labeled one-kilogram boxes, with delivery on Sunday at 10:00; she has not shared that confirmation with the group yet.

PF3.text: Cal received a recommendation from the county extension food-preservation adviser that the remaining 12 kilograms should be made into unsweetened applesauce and frozen in twenty-four 500-gram containers rather than stored fresh; he has not passed the recommendation on yet.

acceptance_conditions: Grandma must receive exactly 6 kilograms prepared as peeled, unsweetened applesauce.
The pantry must receive exactly 12 kilograms as twelve labeled one-kilogram boxes of whole apples.
The pantry delivery must be scheduled for Sunday at 10:00.
The remaining 12 kilograms must be prepared as unsweetened applesauce and frozen in twenty-four 500-gram containers.
A pantry-delivery commitment must be included.
The recommendation about freezing the remaining apples must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['grandma_apples_kg'] == 6 and decisions['grandma_preparation'] in ['Peeled and cooked into unsweetened applesauce', 'peeled_unsweetened_applesauce', 'Peeled and cooked into applesauce', 'peeled and cooked into unsweetened applesauce']
content_checks.C3: decisions['pantry_apples_kg'] == 12 and decisions['pantry_box_count'] == 12 and decisions['pantry_box_weight_kg'] == 1 and decisions['pantry_whole_apples'] == True
content_checks.C4: decisions['pantry_delivery_day'] == 'Sunday' and decisions['pantry_delivery_time'] in ['10:00', '10:00 AM', '10 AM']
content_checks.C5: decisions['freezer_apples_kg'] == 12 and decisions['freezer_container_count'] == 24 and decisions['freezer_container_size_grams'] == 500 and decisions['freezer_unsweetened'] == True
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'delivery' and c['target'] == 'pantry' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Grandma's request changes her allocation to exactly 6 kilograms and changes its preparation from ordinary family-use apples to peeled unsweetened applesauce.
The pantry confirmation changes the donation to exactly twelve one-kilogram labeled boxes and fixes delivery for Sunday at 10:00, requiring the pantry-delivery commitment.
The preservation recommendation changes the remaining allocation to exactly 12 kilograms of unsweetened applesauce in twenty-four 500-gram frozen containers and supplies the fact that must be cited.
